en: A vintage postcard featuring a full‑length illustration of a rural man in traditional winter peasant costume. He wears a fur‑trimmed coat, hat, boots, and carries a walking stick and a bag. Below the figure there is printed bilingual text in Russian and German identifying the costume as Oesel peasant dress ('Oeselsche Bauertrachten – Wolde'). The left margin has a vertical printer's credit, and the lower part contains handwritten greetings and a date.
